newsitem.title: BOTSWANA: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK-Shares ease ahead of holiday.
newsitem.headline: BOTSWANAN STOCKS WEEK-Shares ease ahead of holiday.

text.p: Shares on the Botswana Stock Exchange eased last week in quiet trade ahead of the long weekend, exchange officials said.
Volumes were lower at 51,280 valued at 230,439 pula from the 147,290 shares worth 389,133 pula traded in the previous week.
The index shed 1.97 points to close at 345.82.
Sefalana traded 20 thebe lower at 460 and First National shed 15 thebe to finish at 460.
Trading unchanged were Barclays, Metsef and Sechaba. The remaining seven counters were untraded.
The exchange is closed on Monday, September 30 as the country celebrates its 30th anniversary of independence.
